_comment: Hardcoded allow-list of npubs whose CVM announcements the dashboard may render. Fork this repo and edit THIS FILE for your own deployment - curation is a claim, so it lives in your git history, not in a database. Unknown npub => not rendered. Empty list => nothing rendered (fail closed).

curators.derived_from: secp256k1 key 4ae5fe8e (operator's active signing key; npub re-derived with nak encode npub on 2026-10-04)
curators.note: Registry #1. Publishes the kind-30000 lists referenced by the 'a' tag in provider announcements.

curators.derived_from: secp256k1 key efcb48fd (the nosms provider's own signing key; npub re-derived with nak decode on 2026-10-05, matching the pubkey of the kind-11316 announcement event 6b3e96f4 d=nosms)
curators.note: S5b. Signs the nosms CVM announcement (kind 11316, d=nosms, class cvm:service:sms) on wss://relay.primal.net. Added so the dashboard may render that row; an unknown npub is dropped at collect time (not rendered, ADR-0001 D12a).

curators.derived_from: secp256k1 key e3cc68060448fb92522e87ed7bd91973e2896eae9f744389d0b6890975b4d805 (cvm-lambda's signing key; npub re-derived with `nak encode npub` on 2026-10-06, matching the pubkey of the kind-11316 announcement d=cvm-lambda-01)
curators.note: cvm-lambda. Signs the serverless code-execution CVM announcement (kind 11316, d=cvm-lambda-01, class cvm:service:compute, cvm:req:none) on wss://relay.primal.net, wss://nostr.mom, wss://nos.lol, wss://relay2.contextvm.org. Added so the dashboard may render the row; an unknown npub is dropped at collect time (not rendered, ADR-0001 D12a).

curators.derived_from: secp256k1 key 72a45409ef798d4050e5cba4407928e97d92cd377af8bafe0a23d3552fba2954 (cvm-sms4sats SERVER_SECRET_KEY on testserver2; npub re-derived with `nak encode npub` on 2026-10-08, round-trip verified with `nak decode`)
curators.note: cvm-sms4sats. Will sign the kind-11316 announcement d=cvm-sms4sats-01 (class cvm:service:sms). PRE-REGISTERED while ANNOUNCE=false: cvm-service-kit evidence/announce-readiness-2026-10-08.md shows the paid rail (NWC_URL) empty and the treasury refusing rail_unavailable, so no announcement exists to render yet — this entry is inert until the service announces (an allowlisted npub with no live announcement simply renders nothing; it is not an error).

curators.note: cvm-ppq. Will sign the kind-11316 announcement d=cvm-ppq-01 (class cvm:service:ai).
